name: podcast-to-article
description: Turns YouTube / Xiaoyuzhou podcast links or raw transcripts into polished Chinese long-form articles: keeps the guest's voice with clearly-labelled quotes, restructures around the reader's questions, illustrates the first body chapter and then each remaining chapter after confirmation, and exports the finished article with its images into a local Obsidian vault.

displayDescription.en: Turns a podcast link or transcript into a polished Chinese long-form article — keeps key quotes, illustrates chapter by chapter, and saves to Obsidian.
displayDescription.zh: 把播客链接或逐字稿改写成中文精华长文，保留关键原声并逐章配图，可一键存入 Obsidian。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 用这个 YouTube 或小宇宙链接整理成中文精华长文，先出首章配图
defaultInitPrompt.en: Turn this YouTube or Xiaoyuzhou link into a Chinese long-form article, starting with the first chapter's illustration

quickPrompts.zh: 用这个 YouTube 或小宇宙链接整理成中文精华长文，先出首章配图
quickPrompts.en: Turn this YouTube or Xiaoyuzhou link into a Chinese long-form article, starting with the first chapter's illustration

quickPrompts.zh: 整理这份播客逐字稿，只要文章，暂不配图
quickPrompts.en: Clean up this podcast transcript into an article only — no illustrations for now

quickPrompts.zh: 把这篇成稿和已确认的配图存入我的 Obsidian
quickPrompts.en: Save this finished article and the approved illustrations into my Obsidian
